decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen sits squarely in the bakery's core baking know-how and has won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in consecutive years, so the firm can read its quality signals clearly and build on them.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds directly on the firm's rye bread expertise and survived the 2024 pruning that removed the other new rye breads, which suggests management assessed it as viable and worth keeping.
The marzipan stollen extends the firm's proven stollen competence and is still presented on its own page in 2024, so it fits existing seasonal production and knowledge.
